game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Lava Tube Tunnel Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel, a glowing lava tube: the volcanologist must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before lava imps spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava Tube Tunnel: a glowing lava tube
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava Tube Tunnel, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before lava imps spring the trap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Lava Tube Tunnel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Lava Tube Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 14.
